verdict: RPC endpoint unreachable. A remote service the client tried to call (WMI, SMS Agent Host, the management point) is not responding on the expected port.
fix: Identify the RPC target from the log context (MP, DP, DC, or local service). For local RPC failures, ensure `RpcSs`, `DcomLaunch`, and `RpcEptMapper` services are running. For remote RPC, test `Test-NetConnection <target> -Port 135` from the client and confirm the dynamic RPC port range (49152-65535 on modern Windows) is not blocked between segments. RPC over SMB fallback requires port 445 open to the target.
